title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
International Aerospace Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd (IAMPL) is a 50/50 joint venture between Rolls-Royce and Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), established in 2010 to manufacture high-precision aero engine compressor and gas turbine parts. Over time, IAMPL has become a fully accredited benchmark facility within the global aero engine supply chain, supplying around 200 different parts for advanced civil aero engine programs across Europe, Asia, and North America. The purpose-built facility in Bangalore uses modern machine tools, CMMs, metal spray booths, and NDT lines to complete all manufacturing processes in-house, supporting competitive development and lead times. IAMPL follows global quality standards, digital production systems, and advanced manufacturing techniques to deliver a broad spectrum of aero engine components. The company operates from a 50,000 ft² facility with room for expansion and holds AS 9100, NADCAP, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001 accreditations.

**Role Description**
The Senior Quality Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Hosur, responsible for ensuring that aero engine components meet stringent quality and regulatory requirements. This role involves developing, implementing, and maintaining quality engineering processes, performing inspections and audits, and leading root cause analysis and corrective actions for product and process non-conformities. The Senior Quality Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams in manufacturing, design, and supply chain to drive continuous improvement, reduce defects, and optimize quality performance. Daily tasks include monitoring quality metrics, reviewing documentation, supporting customer and certification audits, and ensuring adherence to global standards and internal procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated expertise in Quality Engineering and Quality Management, with experience in developing and improving quality systems and processes.
* Strong skills in Quality Control and Product Quality, including inspection methods, measurement systems, and defect analysis.
* Experience in Quality Assurance, including audits, compliance with aerospace standards, and documentation control.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering (or related discipline); advanced certifications in quality (e.g., ASQ CQE) are an advantage.
* Background in aerospace or precision manufacturing environments, preferably with familiarity with AS 9100, NADCAP, ISO 14001, and OHSAS/ISO 45001 requirements.
* Proficiency in problem-solving tools (e.g., FMEA, 8D, Root Cause Analysis), statistical quality methods, and continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications, work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, and communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotics Hardware
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
**Senior Mechanical Engineer — Robotics Hardware**
**Location**
- Bangalore
  
  
Instawork Robotics Labs is building Instacore, our proprietary five-camera and IMU wearable capture rig. Hundreds of units operate across India every day, collecting real-world data used to train frontier Physical AI models.
  
  
We are looking for a senior, mechanically focused engineer to own the complete hardware lifecycle for Instacore and future hardware products. This person will independently lead design, prototyping, manufacturing, testing, deployment, logistics, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the mechanical design and development of Instacore and other robotics hardware from initial requirements through production and field deployment.
* Create detailed CAD models, assemblies, engineering drawings, bills of materials, and manufacturing documentation.
* Rapidly prototype and validate designs using 3D printing, machining, fabrication, and off-the-shelf components.
* Design durable mounts, enclosures, fixtures, wearable components, packaging, and protective systems.
* Own design for manufacturability, assembly, serviceability, reliability, and cost.
* Improve cable routing, connector retention, strain relief, thermal management, ingress protection, and resistance to vibration and impact.
* Design packaging and logistics processes that prevent damage during storage and transit.
* Establish verification, stress-testing, quality-control, and acceptance-testing procedures.
* Investigate field failures, determine root causes, and implement corrective improvements across the fleet.
* Own the maintenance and repair strategy for deployed hardware, including spare parts, repair documentation, and technician procedures.
* Manage vendors, fabricators, component suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
* Own component sourcing, inventory planning, hardware logistics, and deployment readiness.
* Work closely with robotics, electrical, firmware, software, operations, and field teams to deliver complete systems.
* Build repeatable processes that allow the hardware fleet to scale reliably across India and APAC.
* Mentor technicians and junior engineers while remaining deeply hands-on.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Product Design, Robotics, or a related discipline.
* \*\*Five to seven years of hands-on experience\*\* designing and delivering physical products or robotics hardware.
* Advanced proficiency with CAD, including complex parts, assemblies, drawings, tolerance definition, and revision management.
* Strong experience with rapid prototyping and 3D printing, including material selection, print orientation, tolerances, and design limitations.
* Experience taking products from early prototypes through low-volume or scaled production.
* Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, fasteners, tolerances, load paths, fatigue, vibration, and impact resistance.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose mechanical failures and implement robust, practical solutions.
* Experience working with vendors and managing manufacturing, sourcing, inventory, packaging, or logistics.
* Ability to independently prioritize work, make engineering decisions, and own outcomes with limited oversight.
* Willingness to travel across India and APAC for vendor visits, deployments, and field investigations.

**Good to have**

* Electrical engineering knowledge, particularly wiring, connectors, sensors, cameras, power systems, printed circuit board integration, and basic electronics troubleshooting.
* Experience designing electromechanical or wearable products.
* Programming proficiency in Python, C++, or another relevant language.
* Experience writing scripts for test automation, hardware validation, data analysis, or manufacturing workflows.
* Familiarity with Raspberry Pi, embedded systems, computer vision hardware, or IoT devices.
* Experience managing engineering documentation and product data using version-control or product-lifecycle-management systems.
* Experience building or leading a small hardware engineering function.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Instacore has a clear, reliable, and scalable hardware architecture.
* New designs move efficiently from requirements through prototype, validation, and deployment.
* Field failures, wire breakages, and transit damage decline measurably.
* Manufacturing, repair, inventory, and logistics processes are documented and repeatable.
* Junior engineers and technicians can assemble, test, and repair units using the systems you establish.
* Hardware development no longer depends on day-to-day involvement from the broader team.

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Head BD & Distribution Alternates AIF - South
description:
SOUTH – BENGALURU

Vantrock Investment Managers LLP

**Vantrock is a multi-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.**
Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Bengaluru, Hyderabad and the wider Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra markets.

**THE SEAT**

**Employer:**
Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures

**Reports to:**
Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder & CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands-on

**Direct reports:**
None at launch. A senior single-contributor seat with a very large number attached

**Location:**
Bengaluru, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across the zone

**Experience:**
10 to 16 years

Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Vantrock is an operator-led real assets platform, and it is multi-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are
**the first strategy, not the platform**
, across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city-centre, dark-store and self-storage formats, and logistics-anchored mixed-use with distribution below and office above.

Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it.
**A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.**

Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.

Founded by
**Anshul Singhal, Founder & CEO**
. Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000+ acres acquired, all litigation-free; 200+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.

**Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops.**
That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.

We hire number twos who want to become number one.

**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLING**

This is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:

– Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing

– Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space, starter and strata office

– Plotted and industrial plot sales

– Pre-leased and yielding assets

– A land strategy

– Private credit

– Data centres and senior living

– In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures

**Multiple product lines, one channel.**
That is why this is a franchise-building job rather than a product-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.

The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal-by-deal co-investment through CIV, co-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co-investment tickets into named assets.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

**Own the zone.**
Build the distribution and IFA network across Bengaluru, Hyderabad and the wider Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra markets. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.

**Not a cold start.**
The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

– The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi-family offices and wealth-platform desks. Target 6 to 8 firms empanelled and live.

– The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go-live, for both the fund and the co-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.

– Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 40 to 60 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.

– Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.

title: Fundraising Assistant

* Oversee implementation of tracking and analytics tags including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Marketo Munchkin.

* Coordinate closely with the US-based Digital Experience lead on priorities, intake, status, escalations, and technical direction.
* Coach and develop team members on Webflow craft, standards, and production discipline.
* Manage relationships with external agencies or freelance contractors when needed.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.

*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 6–9 years of web development experience, including at least 3 years building and maintaining production sites in Webflow.
* At least 2 years in a senior, lead, or management capacity, overseeing the work of other developers or designers.
* Proven portfolio of complex Webflow builds, such as CMS-driven sites or app-like interactions.
* Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including custom code embeds within Webflow.
* Experience integrating and troubleshooting Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform on a website.
* Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and cross-browser and device testing.
* Experience implementing tracking and analytics tags such as GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
* Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals as they relate to site markup, structure, and performance.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Design, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio will be considered.
* Familiarity with version control such as Git for managing custom code is preferred.
* Experience with A/B testing and optimisation tooling is preferred.
* Experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet or Jira is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

* The website is fast, stable, accessible, and free of recurring defects.
* Builds match design intent closely and require minimal rework.
* Forms and tracking reliably capture and pass lead data into Marketo without errors.
* Webflow CMS and components are organised, documented, and maintainable by others.

* A structured, detail-oriented, metrics-driven approach with a strong work ethic and bias toward accuracy.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations to senior stakeholders.
